Jack Heart, 2026-11-13: "in the future Cloud will have names for experiments and it will supply the experiment name to the [Etude] SDK launcher". For this Task that means the launcher is the authority for a run's experiment: a name given at launch (a command argument, or the caller in Python) wins; the file's stem is only the default; training code never needs to name its experiment. This agrees with the rule already built here that the launched file owns the experiment and `track` refuses a differing name. The added piece is that `etude launch` and `etude run` accept the name. scratch/design-train-api.md is updated ("Set up for Etude Cloud" section).
